export_duties_source: US Constitution Art. 1, Sec. 9 (No Tax or Duty shall be laid on Articles exported from any State)
export_duties_source_es: Constitución de EE. UU. Art. 1, Sec. 9 (No se impondrán derechos a los artículos exportados de ningún Estado)
gross_receipts_source: Iowa Department of Revenue (No sales tax or gross receipts tax on wholesale grain sales)
gross_receipts_source_es: Departamento de Ingresos de Iowa (Sin impuesto sobre ventas ni ingresos brutos a la venta mayorista de granos)
transaction_tax_source: No federal or state financial transaction tax on bank operations
transaction_tax_source_es: Sin impuesto financiero federal ni estatal sobre movimientos bancarios
land_tax_source: Iowa Department of Revenue / Iowa State University Extension (Agricultural property tax: ~$30/acre = $74.13/ha)
land_tax_source_es: Departamento de Ingresos de Iowa / Extensión Univ. Estatal de Iowa (Impuesto inmobiliario rural: ~$30/acre = $74,13/ha)
income_tax_source: US Federal Corporate Tax (21%) + Iowa Corporate Income Tax (5.5%), effective ~25% (company rate; most farms file as individuals or pass-throughs)
income_tax_source_es: Impuesto corporativo federal de EE. UU. (21%) + Impuesto de Iowa (5,5%), efectivo ~25% (tasa societaria)
disclaimer: Orientative guide based on public rates as of 2026; not tax advice; consult an accountant.
_review: The agricultural property tax (~$30/acre, rounded to 75 USD/ha) and effective ~25% combined corporate income tax rate are estimates not yet read in a primary Iowa Department of Revenue or ISU publication; income tax uses a company rate. Provisional.
